messages:
Maria G.: Quick follow-up from today's DR sim — captured a few recurring gaps. I'm putting a short action list here so owners + ETAs are clear. Please ack and drop rough dates.

Ajay P.: ack — will take the multi-region routing checklist ownership. Planning spike tomorrow to validate weight fallbacks. ETA: 2026-04-02.

Sasha N.: noted for backup verification. I'll run a full restore from cold backup and time it. Targeting 2026-04-06.

Kevin L.: I can handle the restore runbook polish and add step-by-step checks for the DBA team. Will add pre-flight checks and a quick troubleshooting flow. ETA: 2026-04-01.

Maria G.: thanks — please add the changes to the runbook repo and post the PR link here when ready. Also, flag any manual steps that can be automated.

oncall-bot: Incident exercise completed: DR-sim-2026-03-24. Summary report available at https://internal/reports/dr-sim-2026-03-24.pdf

Lisa T.: observed a pattern where KV cache priming caused >300ms cold-start spikes during failover. Proposing a pre-warm stage in the routing policy. Will draft policy changes. ETA: 2026-03-30.

Samir R.: I'll add telemetry alerts for repeated KV miss spikes (>=3 in 10m) and link to the new dashboard. ETA: 2026-03-29.

Ajay P.: question for Kevin — when you update runbook, can you include the policy for model variant fallback? we saw two requests routed to an incompatible quantized variant during the sim.

Kevin L.: yes — I'll include a compatibility matrix and add explicit rollback steps if variant mismatch detected. Also adding a quick grep command to validate model metadata:

```
# check model metadata for quantization compatibility
jq '.model.name, .runtime.quantization' model_manifest.json
```

Sasha N.: for backup verification, I'll capture checksums and restore time. Will add a small script to validate data integrity post-restore and push to the ops-tools repo.

Maria G.: good — let's avoid multi-day ownership ambiguity. Quick table:
- Multi-region routing policy: Ajay P. — ETA 2026-04-02
- Runbook + rollback steps: Kevin L. — ETA 2026-04-01
- Backup full restore + integrity script: Sasha N. — ETA 2026-04-06
- KV cache pre-warm policy: Lisa T. — ETA 2026-03-30
- Telemetry/alerts for repeated KV misses: Samir R. — ETA 2026-03-29

Maria G.: request — please mark items done in the shared spreadsheet and paste links to PRs or playbook commits. We'll run a short verification game day on 2026-04-08 if all items land.

Kevin L.: +1. I'll open the PR for runbook edits today and tag @Maria G.

Ajay P.: will share a small test harness for routing weights so we can simulate region loss without bringing infra down.

Samir R.: created initial alert rule in staging, will promote after we validate. Link: https://internal/alerts/kv-miss-rule (staging)

Lisa T.: drafting pre-warm policy now, will push to the RFC channel for feedback.

Maria G.: thanks everyone. If anything slips, ping me directly. Otherwise we'll reconvene 2026-04-07 for a quick readiness check before the game day. :thumbsup:

Sasha N.: one more note — I noticed recurring S3 permission hiccups on recovery steps. I'll include a quick perms checklist in the restore runbook.

Kevin L.: thanks — that'll help.

oncall-bot: Reminder — follow-up actions are due in the DR-tracker spreadsheet. Next automated check-in: 2026-03-28 09:00 UTC.
